label: start
name: starting architecture
last_analysis: All 9 trials scored 0 on dev and 0 in training. That covers the baseline conv net, recipes with 1 or 2 epochs, deeper trunks, per-layer heads, dense remapping heads, a transformer and a flat MLP. Because the MLP and the dense heads also failed, a mismatch between the action grid and the observation grid is unlikely to be the only cause. The common factor is the recipe. Every run used gamma 0.95 or 0.97, entropy 0.005 to 0.01, and either 2 epochs with batch 2048 or 1 epoch with batch 4096. No run tested high gamma, high entropy, small batches or many updates. The remaining bottlenecks are probably exploration and credit assignment: the +1 exact-build bonus and a correctly timed DONE are far apart and rare. With only success numbers to go on, I cannot tell which hidden twist applies. This last round therefore spends the trials on untested recipe settings (gamma 0.99, entropy 0.02 to 0.03, smaller and more frequent updates) and on one new trunk with a wider view of the board.
